_about: Store census for ADVI_COTBKF.TO-CB-b-3, read by commonwealth_price_coverage.py. Each entry is one stored thing checked for being a daily price series; READ_PRICE_SERIES entries carry the reader spec, the rest are checked and not read, with the reason. Verdicts: READ_PRICE_SERIES, NAME_KEYED, DERIVED_NOT_READ, NOT_PRICE_SERIES. Authored by 0.9.0_WK_ADVI_COTBKF~6 on 2026-10-06 from S3 listings and schema reads (row ADVI_COTBKF-W6-S5 says why the locations live here and not in the script).
